description: Project on Protocol Based Management of Hypertension and Diabetes at Primary Care Level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2026-01-12 granted approval to obtain a Grant of US$ 242,125 from Resolve to Save Lives. Inc. to implement the Project on Protocol Based Management of Hypertension and Diabetes at Primary Care Level implemented in the Districts of Kalutara, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Matale, Galle, Colombo and Gampaha. Accordingly, the Ministry of Health and Mass Media has entered into an Agreement with Resolve to Save Lives, Inc., and the period of the said Agreement is scheduled to expire on 2026-09-30. As of 2026-05-31, a balance of US$ 50,320 has been identified from the said funds. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to extend the project period until 2027-12-31, enabling to further implement the project activities effectively using the balance provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.
